summary.text: Al Landis is a Republican state senator from Ohio who has represented District 31 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Ohio House from 2011 to 2018 and as a Tuscarawas County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Al Landis was born in Dover, Ohio, and graduated from Dover High School.
His career experience includes work in sales and marketing as an inside sales representative and district representative for Greer Steel Company.
He served as a Tuscarawas County commissioner for four years and is a member of the National Rifle Association, the Ohio Farm Bureau and the Tuscarawas County Chamber of Commerce.
Landis represented District 98 in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2011 to 2018, when term limits prevented another run.
He took office in the Ohio Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Jay Hottinger.

Ballotpedia's 2023–2024 listing shows him as vice chair of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, with seats on the Energy and Public Utilities and Small Business and Economic Opportunity committees.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Laura Sirot in the general election.
